tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po re zhig sngags pas dam tshig pa spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa la sogs pa ltar dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i sku la lha mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs shing*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba bdag la bstim pa'i dbang gis/ rang gi lus kyi rten khog pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi gnas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa dang*/ brten pa khams dang yi ge rnams lha mo nyi shu rtsa lngar bsgom par bya ste/ de yang snying gi nang du padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa ltar bsam par bya'o// de bzhin du spyi bo pullī ra mā la yar pu las myur zhing rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma dang po gnyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcas shing*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis gyis mda' dang gzhu/ g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis dung dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// spyi gtsug dzā landha rar dzā las ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ dkar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon ser zhing phyag dang po gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang*/ lhag ma'i phyag rnams kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba/ g.yon rnams kyis ril ba spyi blugs/ utpa la/ dril bu/ bum pa/ pusti bsnams pa'o// rna ba g.yas pa au ḍyan du u las gser gyi mdog can ma/ ser mo zhal gcig phyag bcu/ phyag g.yas rnams na phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ g.yon rnams na dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ padma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa'o// rtag pa arbu dar a las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma phyag g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/

g.yon gnyis kyis ril ba spyi blugs dang dbyu gu bsnams pa'o// rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rīr go las hūm̐ sgra rab tu sgrogs ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon padma ser po bsnams pa'o// smin ma'i dbus su rā me shwa rir ra las sgrol ma sku'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu bsnams pa'o// mig gnyis de bī ko ṭar de las 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o// phrag pa gnyis mā la war ma las gzhan 'joms ma/ khro mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis skye gnas kyi steng du zhags pa 'dzin pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o// mtshan khung gnyis kā ma rū par ka las bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ chu srin la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i shing dang rin po che/ g.yon na padma dang bum pa bsnams pa'o// nu ma gnyis o ḍir o las 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas gar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o// lte ba tri sha ku ner tri las mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o// sna rtse ko sa lar ko las 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel bar mdzad ma khro mo mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas pa lcags kyus gza' brgyad 'gugs shing g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa'o// kha ka liṅgar ka las bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams na rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams na rin po che zhags pa/ dbyu gu/ bum pa bsnams pa'o// mgrin pa lambā kar lam̐ las sgrol ma gsung gi dbang phyug ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon gnag pa/ phyag g.yas na padma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri bsnams pa'o// snying ga kāñtsir kā las sgrol ma thugs kyi dbang phyug ma nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ padma/ g.yon na dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu bsnams pa'o// 'dom bar hi mā la yar hi las yongs su smin par byed ma/ khro mo dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang gzhu bsnams pa'o// rtags kyi rtse pre ta pu rir pre las 'gugs par byed pa'i khro mo nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams na ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyu gu/ g.yon rnams na thod pa zhags pa/ mgo bo bsnams pa'o// bshang lam gṛ ha de bar gṛ las zhi ba chen mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ phyag g.yas rnams na phreng ba mchog sbyin dbyu gu/ g.yon na padma ril ba spyi blugs pusti bsnams pa'o// brla gnyis sau rāṣṭar sau las chags pa 'joms ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon pa utpa la dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya rked par 'jog pa'o// byin pa su warṇaṇa dwī bar su las bde ba thams cad sgrub ma dmar ser/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o// rkang lag gi sor mo bcu drug na ga rar na las rnam par rgyal ma ngang pa'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing g.yas kyi gnyis pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rdo rje khu tshur dkur 'jog pa'o// bol gong gnyis sindhur si las sdug bsngal thams cad sreg ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa'o// mthe bong ma ror ma las dngos grub thams cad 'byung ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'o// pus mo gnyis ku lu tā ra ku las yongs su rdzogs par byed ma dkar mo khyu mchog la gnas pa'i khro mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa bgrang phreng dang g.yon pas rtse gsum bsnams pa'o// de ltar lha thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal btab nas/ slar yang de dag dang rjes su mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa spyan drangs pa bstim la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la bstim/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas phyi nang gi gtso mo la don yod grub pa dang*/ gzhan thugs kyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ gsung gi lha rnams la 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ sku'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de dag la phyi dang nang dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pas bstod la spyi dang so so'i rnam pa la rim pa bzhin yid gzung bar bya'o// de nas bsgom par 'dod na man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang bsgom par bya ste/ man ngag ni gzhan dang thun mong ba nyid do// de ltar mnyam par gzhag pa las langs nas gang la 'phro bar gyur pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa yang ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa de srid bzla bar bya'o// gtor ma la sogs pa'i yan lag gzhan ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i man ngag gi rim pa grub pa brnyes pa'i kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/// /
༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
